items.source: Nullability rules are declared using Nullable, NonNullApi, and JSR-305 javax.annotation.Nonnull annotations. By default (no annotation use), a package and its types are considered allowing null values in return values and method parameters. Nullability rules are expressed by annotating a package with a JSR-305 meta annotation such as Spring's NonNullApi. All types of the package inherit the package rule. Subpackages do not inherit nullability rules and must be annotated themselves.
items.translation: 空值规则是使用 `Nullable`、`NonNullApi` 以及 JSR-305 的 `javax.annotation.Nonnull` 注解来声明的。默认情况下（不使用任何注解），一个包及其类型被视为允许在返回值和方法参数中使用 null 值。空值规则通过用 JSR-305 元注解（如 Spring 的 `NonNullApi`）标注一个包来表达。该包中的所有类型都会继承此包规则。子包不会继承空值规则，必须自行进行标注。

items.source: javax.annotation.Nonnull is suitable for composition of meta-annotations and expresses via javax.annotation.Nonnull#when() in which cases non-nullability is applicable.
items.translation: javax.annotation.Nonnull 适用于元注解的组合，并通过 javax.annotation.Nonnull#when() 表达非空性适用的情况。

items.source: Determine whether a MethodParameter is explicitly annotated to be considered nullable. Nullability rules are discovered from method and parameter annotations. A MethodParameter is considered nullable when javax.annotation.Nonnull is set to one of javax.annotation.meta.When#UNKNOWN, javax.annotation.meta.When#NEVER, or javax.annotation.meta.When#MAYBE.
items.translation: 确定MethodParameter是否被显式注解为可空。可空性规则是从方法和参数注解中发现的。当javax.annotation.Nonnull设置为javax.annotation.meta.When#UNKNOWN、javax.annotation.meta.When#NEVER或javax.annotation.meta.When#MAYBE之一时，MethodParameter被视为可空。

items.source: Determine whether ElementType in the scope of Method requires non-null values. Non-nullability rules are discovered from class and package annotations. Non-null is applied when javax.annotation.Nonnull is set to javax.annotation.meta.When#ALWAYS.
items.translation: 确定在 Method 作用域内的 ElementType 是否需要非空值。非空性规则是从类和包注解中发现的。当 javax.annotation.Nonnull 设置为 javax.annotation.meta.When#ALWAYS 时，应用非空规则。

items.source: Determine whether ElementType in the scope of type requires non-null values. Non-nullability rules are discovered from class and package annotations. Non-null is applied when javax.annotation.Nonnull is set to javax.annotation.meta.When#ALWAYS.
items.translation: 确定在 `type` 作用域内的 `ElementType` 是否需要非空值。非空性规则是从类和包注解中发现的。当 `javax.annotation.Nonnull` 设置为 `javax.annotation.meta.When#ALWAYS` 时，应用非空规则。

items.source: Determine whether ElementType in the scope of AnnotatedElement requires non-null values. This method determines default javax.annotation.Nonnull nullability rules from the annotated element
items.translation: 确定在 AnnotatedElement 作用域内的 ElementType 是否需要非空值。 此方法根据已注解元素确定默认的 javax.annotation.Nonnull nullability 规则。

items.translation: 确定在 AnnotatedElement 的范围内，ElementType 是否需要非空值。

items.translation: 确定在 Method 的作用域中，ElementType 是否需要非空值。

items.source: Utility methods to introspect nullability rules declared in packages, classes and methods.
items.translation: 用于检查包、类和方法中声明的空值规则的实用方法。

items.source:
@org.jspecify.annotations.NullMarked
package com.example;
Nullable selectively permits null values for method return values or method parameters by annotating the method respectively the parameters: 
public class ExampleClass {

        String shouldNotReturnNull(@Nullable String acceptsNull, String doesNotAcceptNull) {
                // …
        }

        @Nullable
        String nullableReturn(String parameter) {
                // …
        }
}
items.translation:
@org.jspecify.annotations.NullMarked
package com.example;
Nullable 通过分别注解方法或参数，选择性地允许方法返回值或方法参数为 null： 
public class ExampleClass {

        String shouldNotReturnNull(@Nullable String acceptsNull, String doesNotAcceptNull) {
                // …
        }

        @Nullable
        String nullableReturn(String parameter) {
                // …
        }
}
